name: Start Storybook
description: User clicks the Storybook button to start a Storybook dev server

scenarios.description: User successfully starts Storybook server and browser navigates to it

template.introduction:
**Storybook Started Successfully**

Started Storybook on port {{port}} for package **{{selected_package}}**.

events.storybook.button.clicked: User clicked Storybook button (action: {{action}}, status: {{current_status}}, package: {{selected_package}})

scenarios.description: User stops a running Storybook server

template.introduction:
**Storybook Stopped**

Stopped Storybook and cleaned up resources.

events.storybook.stopped: Stopped session `{{session_id}}`, released port {{port}}, restored {{restored_panel}} panel
